'''Calioc''' was a wealthy [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] and [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] enthusiast. Acting as the benefactor of the prominent [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] [[Korlen Skimmer]] at the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Calioc became fearful that her investment in Skimmer would prove a bad one when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] took an interest in Skimmer's skills. Hiring an investigator to determine the nature of these threats, Calioc refused to pull Skimmer from a race when her agents warned of foul-play.<ref name="EV" />
